schools.name: Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
Beauxbatons Academy of Magic
schools.notes: Has a team [GoF]; no canon houses. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Durmstrang Institute
schools.notes: Krum is a student and the Bulgarian Seeker [GoF 7]. Exact location unknown; assigned to Bulgaria [inferred]. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Ilvermorny School of Witchcraft and Wizardry
Mahoutokoro School of Magic
schools.notes: They train over the sea in storms [PM-Mahoutokoro]. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Castelobruxo
schools.notes: Former students on the Tarapoto Tree-Skimmers [PM]. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Uagadou School of Magic
schools.notes: No information about Quidditch: team [FILLER]. Country: Mountains of the Moon (Uganda) [PM]. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Koldovstoretz
schools.notes: In Russia [PM-Wizarding Schools]: youth players for Russian clubs come from here (the rest of Eastern Europe, from Durmstrang). They play on uprooted trees [PM-Wizarding Schools]. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Wollemi Academy of Magic
schools.notes: [FILLER] JKR says there are eleven major schools [PM-Wizarding Schools] but names eight: this is one of the three unnamed ones. Hidden on Mount Wollemi (Blue Mountains, New South Wales). Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Kapadokya Institute of Magic
schools.notes: [FILLER] One of the three schools with no canon name. Carved into the fairy chimneys of Cappadocia (Turkey). No league in the Middle East: graduates also go to Eastern Europe. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).

schools.name: Nilgiri School of Magic
schools.notes: [FILLER] One of the three schools with no canon name. In the Nilgiri hills (southern India), among the mist. Houses [FILLER]: invented from the region's folklore (see docs/design/07 §6).
